description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price given for Coconut, This Order shall come into effect from 25th September 2020
reasoning: This gazette content establishes maximum retail prices for coconuts through an order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. This constitutes a regulatory measure and falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it creates binding compliance requirements for producers, distributors, and traders regarding pricing regulations.
